In comparing the life expectancies of two models of refrigerators, the average years before complete breakdown of 10 model A refrigerators is compared with that of 15 model B refrigerators. The 90% confidence interval estimate of the difference is (6, 12). Which of the following is the most reasonable conclusion?
Option A: The mean life expectancy of one model is twice that of the other.
Option B: The mean life expectancy of one model is 6 years, while the mean life expectancy of the other is 12 years.
Option C: The probability that the life expectancies are different is 0.90.
Option D: We should be 90% confident that the difference in life expectancies is between 6 and 12 years.
